name: Scan-Tastic Spectacular Promo Pack [Ho-oh & Rapidash]
cleanName: Scan Tastic Spectacular Promo Pack Ho oh and Rapidash
extCardText: Evolve your battles to the next level with Pokémon-e: Expedition, the latest expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. And Nintendo Power has two cards that you won't find anywhere else—Rapidash and Ho-oh! Scan the cards into Nintendo's new e-Reader to create fun effects on your Game Boy Advance. Scan the short bar of a card's code to view special data about the card. Or scan the long bar on both cards to conjure the wild GBA minigame Fire Hoops—race Rapidash through a flaming obstacle course while Ho-oh soars overhead!
